wallSpeed.description: Wall scroll speed as a multiple of the game's 300 px/s. Wall pairs keep their spacing, so faster walls also come more often. Applies to the walls on screen immediately. Higher values leave less time to line up with each opening.
wallSpeed.adjustment_guide: The main pace lever. Raise in steps of about 0.1 while the player clears several walls in a row; lower after quick crashes, or for relax.

gapSize.description: Height of the opening between each pair of walls, in px (the game's own is 200; the cat is about 105 px tall). Applies to wall pairs spawned from now on. Smaller openings demand more precise flying.
gapSize.adjustment_guide: The main precision lever. Widen (240-320) for relax or a struggling player; narrow (150-180) for focus and grit once the player passes walls reliably. Change by about 20 px at a time.

gapVariation.description: How far the opening moves up and down from one wall pair to the next, as a multiple of the game's own (about 90-120 px either way). 0 keeps every opening at the same height. Higher values demand bigger climbs and dives between walls.
gapVariation.adjustment_guide: Lower (0-0.5) for relax, so the player can settle into a rhythm. Raise (1.2-1.5) for grit and to train timing and anticipation.

adjustment_instructions:
Flapcat Steampunk 2 is a one-button flyer: the cat flies up while the player holds a touch or the mouse and falls when they let go. Pairs of walls scroll in from the right with an opening between them; flying through an opening scores a point, and touching a wall or leaving the screen ends the run; the score resets and a new run starts.
Levers: wallSpeed sets the pace (higher = less time to line up); gapSize sets how precise each pass must be (smaller = harder); gapVariation sets how far the cat must climb or dive between walls (higher = harder).
- relax: wallSpeed 0.6-0.8, gapSize 260-320, gapVariation 0-0.5.
- focus: wallSpeed 0.9-1.1, gapSize 170-200, gapVariation 0.8-1.0.
- grit: wallSpeed 1.2-1.6, gapSize 140-170, gapVariation 1.2-1.5; ease gapSize back by 20 after several quick crashes.
- joy: wallSpeed 0.9-1.1, gapSize 220-260, gapVariation 0.8-1.0, so the player strings together long runs.
Change one lever at a time, in small steps (wallSpeed about 0.1, gapSize about 20); a run that ends within a few walls means the game is too hard.
skill_adjustment_instructions:
Flapcat Steampunk 2 trains Timing and Action (holding and releasing at the right moment), Perceptual Speed (reading the next opening early) and Attention (sustained concentration through long runs).
- timing, action: narrow gapSize (150-180) at moderate wallSpeed (0.9-1.1), raising gapVariation to 1.2-1.5 as runs lengthen.
- perceptual-speed: raise wallSpeed gradually (1.1-1.5) with gapSize 200-240 so the challenge is reacting in time, not precision.
- attention: steady settings (wallSpeed 1.0, gapSize 180-200, gapVariation 1.0) held for long runs; avoid sudden changes.
notes: Flapcat Steampunk 2's difficulty knobs, matching static/skillprintShim.js, ../parameters.json and GameAdjustmentTester's 'flapcat-steampunk-2' keys.
